outcome: death from any cause through day 28

citations.text: All the data were available to all the authors, who vouch for the accuracy and completeness of the data as well as the adherence of the trial to the protocol, which is available at NEJM.org and includes the statistical analysis plan.

The primary objective of the trial was to assess the efficacy of nirmatrelvir plus ritonavir as compared with placebo by comparing the percentage of patients with Covid-19–related hospitalization or death from any cause through day 28 in the two groups.

The primary analysis compared proportions of patients in the two groups who were hospitalized for Covid-19 or died from any cause through day 28, using the Kaplan–Meier method to account for all patients, including those prematurely withdrawn from the trial or lost to follow-up.

5.1.reasoning: The paper states that death from any cause through day 28 is part of the primary end point and that the protocol with the statistical analysis plan is available, and the reported results follow this plan; however, neither the protocol nor the cited registration (NCT04960202) is given a date, so only the paper's word places the plan before the unblinded data were seen.

citations.text: Nine deaths were reported in the placebo group and none in the nirmatrelvir group.
All 13 deaths occurred in the placebo group.

5.2.reasoning: Death from any cause counted through a single fixed time point (day 28) can be measured in only one way, so there was no choice among several measurements of this outcome.
